text:
Pesticides, which are chemicals used to kill insects, weeds and fungi, are applied to crops in almost every farming region. This essay will discuss the main advantages and disadvantages before explaining my own view.

On the positive side, pesticides protect crops from insects, weeds and disease. Without them farmers could lose a large share of their harvest, which would raise food prices and leave more people hungry. They also allow fruit and vegetables to look attractive and to last longer in shops, so less food is thrown away. A grower whose orchard is hit by a destructive insect, for example, may lose most of the fruit within weeks unless the pest is controlled. For many families, cheaper and more reliable food is a real benefit.

On the negative side, however, pesticides can harm people, wildlife and water. Residues may stay on food, chemicals wash into rivers and kill useful insects such as bees, and pests gradually become resistant, which forces farmers to use stronger products. Farm workers who handle these chemicals without protection may also suffer from illness. Nevertheless, the harm can be reduced. Integrated pest management, which combines natural predators, crop rotation and small amounts of spraying only when needed, protects harvests while using far fewer chemicals. Strict rules on which products are allowed and on safe use would also help. Farmers who are trained to spray carefully, at the right time and in the right amount, can protect their crops while limiting the damage to nearby streams.

In conclusion, pesticides play an important role in feeding the world, but their effects on health and the environment are serious. On balance, I believe that they should be used sparingly and under strict control, alongside safer methods.

analysis.type_vi: A/D: thuốc trừ sâu trong nông nghiệp

plan.think: Mở bài định nghĩa thuốc trừ sâu (hoá chất diệt côn trùng, cỏ dại, nấm); kết luận chọn dùng hạn chế dưới kiểm soát chặt.
Bảo vệ mùa màng khỏi côn trùng, cỏ dại, bệnh; giữ giá thực phẩm thấp; trái cây trông đẹp và để lâu nên ít lãng phí. Ví dụ vườn bị côn trùng phá có thể mất phần lớn quả trong vài tuần.

Dư lượng trên thực phẩm, hoá chất trôi xuống sông, hại ong, sâu bệnh kháng thuốc, công nhân nông trại ốm. Nevertheless: quản lý dịch hại tổng hợp (thiên địch, luân canh, phun ít khi cần) và quy định nghiêm ngặt.
Dùng hạn chế, kiểm soát chặt, kèm phương pháp an toàn hơn.
